Lilia approaches her home, she sets up in the garden, around the feeder and bird houses for the ravens and crows that frequent her house. Again she sets up a small altar, similar to the one she made when casting Hallow. On the Raven Queen banner, she lays out holy water, incense, and the raven skull. Then she sighs and pulls out a small package wrapped in cloth. When she opens it, there is a necklace, a silver chain with black angel wings for the pendant, on the back in the inscription, *“Even with dark wings you will always be an angel.”*  She places it in the center of the altar and begins to speak, it’s not a prayer like usual, but rather as if she is having a conversation.
Web hands ♪ a necklace of fireball with 2 beads on it. "These may help"

“I know you prefer to take dark and painful memories. I might have been holding onto this one a little too long. But if I am to die today, I want to let it go, I think I am ready for that.” She looks down at the tarnished necklace a little sad to be offering it. “Lady Cecelia gave it to me. My wings had been dimming for quite some time, and I was losing my ability to fly. She knew it was upsetting me, because I didn’t want to stop following you, the Raven Queen. I knew it was taboo and I knew what it was doing to me, but the draw I felt to you was greater than that. On the ship traveling here, Lady Cecelia gave me this necklace on the anniversary of my working for her...That was the same day the storm hit. The waves were massive and crashing over the sides on the ship. Me and Lady Cecelia went below deck and that was probably our first mistake. We hit something, I went to see what happened, leaving her behind. We were taking on water, then there was another jerk of the boat, we hit something else. I tried to run back to her, but then the ship jerked again, I fell.. Or hit the wall.. When I came to, the water in the ship was waist deep. When look finally made it back to the room, there was a gaping hole where water was rushing in, Lady Cecelia was nowhere to be found. Again there was another jerk of what was left of the boat. I was plunged into the icy water, the shock left me stiff and my lungs began to fill with water. Everything was getting darker and darker, at this point I couldn’t fly anymore, I was trapped in the deep depths of this black and icy hell.”

She takes a deep breath a little shaky from reliving the moment then continues “I awoke on a cold and gritty sandy shore, the first thing I saw was a Jackalope who saved me, Viola. Then I saw the remnants of the wreckage. There was nothing left… it was all gone, I was alone. Then in the sand a few feet away, I saw it. The necklace. Almost cruel that it too survived when no one else hadn’t.” She pauses, and Lilias speech changes back to the tone of her usual prayers “I offer this memory to you now. I no longer wish to hold onto it. Please give me the strength to keep fighting today and to save others. If in the end I do not live, let me at least make sure others do.”
